title: Stone walls after the first shelter works
applies_when: Wooden shelter is functional and labor is available to improve fire resistance.
approach: Use nearby chunks to supply a stonecutter and set a limited block target. Stonecutting needs a bill and worker; loose chunks are not building blocks.
Replace vulnerable walls in small sections as blocks become available. Preserve roof support and entrances during the work.
Use surplus labor for block production instead of taking the only cook or grower away from urgent work. Do not postpone tonight's shelter for an entire stone base.
verify: Research availability, bill, chunks, completed blocks and roof support.
reconsider: The bill competes with food or essential construction, or sufficient blocks already exist.
